notes.title: 🚨 Update 2: Loadout Overhaul + New Vehicle
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey Loopers![/b][/p][p] [/p][p]A big update just hit the garage. This one changes how you build your loadouts, how weapons and hopes behave, and brings a brand new vehicle to the fight. Let’s go over the details:[/p][p]
[/p][h2]🆕 New things[/h2][h3]
[b]• 🚗 Vehicle upgrade tree has been completely removed[/b]
[/h3][p]Now every vehicle is completely independent from the weapons and their special abilities (we call them Hopes). This means you can now create any combination of [b]Vehicle–Weapon–Hope[/b]. One vehicle, one weapon, and one hope are unlocked by default, the rest you’ll need to unlock with currency.[/p][h3]
[b]• 🔚 Vehicle level is gone[/b]
[/h3][p]As a result of the above, we’ve removed the vehicle leveling system entirely.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]• 🐆 New Vehicle – The Prowler[/b]
[/h3][p]A very agile and drifty vehicle with lower durability. Great for dodgers and drifters![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217088/26242bfbae217a2bc9b3e90658dc96371e9a53ec.png"][/img][/p][h3]
[b]• ⚙️ Unique passive ability per vehicle[/b]
[/h3][p]Each vehicle now comes with a unique passive that defines its playstyle and synergy potential. Explore and experiment![/p][h3]
[b]• 🔫 Weapons are now truly unique[/b]
[/h3][p]No more variants. Similar ones were reworked or removed. Now we have [b]5 completely distinct weapons[/b] (with more coming soon!). Each weapon has [b]12 upgrades[/b] in the Loadout menu: some are stat boosts, others are major gameplay changers. Check them out![/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217088/186e1549aaf266f87965ada6e753ffa080e255a9.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]• 🌠 Hopes are unique too[/b]
[/h3][p]We’ve cleaned up redundant ones and tweaked the rest. There are now [b]8 fully unique Hopes[/b], each with a distinct identity.[/p][h3]
[b]• 🛒 Shop overhaul[/b]
[/h3][p]Most shop items are still around, but a few have been removed or shifted into weapon upgrades. [b]New items have been added too![/b] You can now buy upgrades for previously untouched areas like Spare Parts Damage, AoE, and Crew Member damage.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]• ⏸️ New Pause Menu[/b]
[/h3][p]More beautiful, more usable, and with tabs to inspect your current build and more info during the run.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]• 🏁 New End Screen[/b]
[/h3][p]Also revamped with better visuals and more useful data. Still a work in progress — we’ll keep improving it.[/p][h3]
[b]• 🎮 Gamepad improvement[/b]
[/h3][p]You can now navigate menus using the analog stick.[/p][h3]
[b]• ⚖️ Tons of balancing[/b][/h3][h3][/h3][p]Weapons, Hopes, Vehicle stats, Enemies, Currency drops, Prices, and more, have been rebalanced for a better progress.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🛠️ Bugs Fixed[/h2][p]• 🛠️ Settings menu now stores changes correctly[/p][p]• 🔄 Rerolling an upgrade no longer shows Crew Members incorrectly[/p][p]• 🛡️ Deflection chance was not working, now it is![/p][p]• 🌐 Fixed some localization text issues[/p][h3]
[/h3][h3]As always, thanks for playing and giving feedback! More to come very soon.[/h3][p] [/p][h2]👉 Join the community on Discord and let us know what you think: [url="https://discord.gg/driveloop"]https://discord.gg/driveloop[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Patch notes for the Update 1 Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the feedback! This quick hotfix addresses several issues and improves the overall experience, especially for Endless mode and reward scaling.

[h2]🛠 General Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Garage panels now properly scale for Steam Deck aspect ratio
[*]Fixed an issue where the Straylight model wasn’t showing
[*]Armor cap now correctly enforced (70%)
[*]Fixed rare case of two dynamic events spawning at the same time
[/list]

[h2]💰 Currency & Rewards Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Currency drops now properly spawn in Endless Mode
[*]Quitting a run now gives rewards as if you had lost
[*]Event rewards now scale with difficulty level
[*]Bosses now drop currency that also scales with difficulty
[*]Currency icon size reduced on minimap for clarity
[/list]

[h2]🔁 Endless Mode Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Tuned difficulty values to improve pacing and balance
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1: Endless Mode, Garage Boost, Cloud Save & More!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Loopers![/h2]

We’ve rolled out a big update packed with fresh features, balance changes, and improvements. Here’s what’s new:

[h2][b]New Features & Modes[/b][/h2]
- Super Hard difficulty (unlocked after Normal)
- Endless Mode (unlocked after Normal)
- Stat upgrades when all equipment is maxed — choose between stat boosts and/or extra currency
- New dynamic event: Escort the Wagon
- Currency drops from enemies (pickups like XP spheres)
- Upgrade rerolls (1 by default per run, you can buy more in the garage)

[h2][b]Balance & Gameplay Tweaks[/b][/h2]
- Alfred Fumes slightly buffed  
- Removed one level from Plasma Ring, moved buffs to the previous level
- Increased vehicle XP and currency rewards per run
- Improved enemy visuals (fixed blurry effect)
- Improved damage numbers visualization, they are sharper now

[h2][b]Garage[/b][/h2]
- Reworked garage items: higher percentages, lower prices, and more upgrade stacks for almost every item
- Added several new items to the garage (rerolls, currency drop chance, piercing chance and amount, weapon damage...)

[h2][b]Quality of Life & Fixes[/b][/h2]
- Cloud Save implemented
- Fixed Paris map collisions and small issues
- Added aim mode shortcut to the control hints at the start of each level
- Fixed small issue with Blue Drone, now should be less strong and more balanced
- Earned currency now shown below the minimap
- Various minor improvements

Thank you for playing and supporting Driveloop: Survivors!  
If you’re enjoying the game, please consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183730/Driveloop_Survivors/][b]Steam review[/b][/url] — and join our [url=https://discord.gg/YjGATbJeg9][b]Discord[/b][/url] to share feedback and follow the journey. Stay tuned, more exciting updates are on the way :).

See you soon, Loopers!

notes.title: Demo Update - We heard you!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Driveloop Demo Update - New Features, Tweaks & Fixes![/b][/h1]

Hey Loopers!

We've been hard at work improving the Driveloop demo based on your feedback, and today we're rolling out a new update packed with improvements, balance and tweaks.

[h2][b]🚗 Gameplay & UI Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]New End Screen Stats! Now you'll see a short breakdown of your run when you finish. This is a first version, and it will improve with every update.
[*]Player Stats Panel on Pause Screen. Keep track of your progress mid-run! Also will be improving over time.
[*]Better Upgrade UI. Hover effects and materials adjusted for better clarity. Now it also shows if an item is new, and if it's not, shows the current level and the max level it can reach.
[*]New level up sound. 
[/list]
[h2][b]🔥 Combat & Balance Tweaks[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Ion Beam Buffed. More damage, more destruction!
[*]Sawblades Buffed. Get ready to shred through enemies more effectively.
[*]Kamikaze Flocks Nerfed. Less frustrating, more fair.
[*]Fire Sound Adjusted. A bit lower now for better audio balance.
[*]Enemy Projectile Adjustments. Now slightly bigger and deals a bit less damage.
[*]Crew Member Pickups Improved. No more weird collisions with the balloon. Smooth pickups all the way!
[*]Ranged drones slightly tuned down.
[/list]
[h2][b]🔧 Bug Fixes & Other Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed some Typos in Descriptions.
[*]Removed some wrong collisions on some parts of the map.
[*]Fixed some issues on the roads visibility.
[*]New Music Added. More tracks to keep the adrenaline pumping!
[*]Crew member pickup arrows changed to something bigger and more visible.
[/list]

We’d love to hear what you think about the new demo update! Jump in, test the latest changes, and let us know your thoughts. Your feedback helps shape Driveloop!

👉 Join our Discord to chat with us and the community: https://discord.gg/E7ZNTVYPf7

Thanks for your support, and keep those engines roaring! 🔥

notes.title: First Demo Update
notes.notes:
🚗🔥 Driveloop Update – Ramming, Combat, and XP Tweaks! 🔥🚗  

Hey loopers! Another update is here, packed with balance improvements, bug fixes, and quality-of-life enhancements to keep your runs fast, smooth, and action-packed!  

[b]🏎️ Ramming & Combat Upgrades[/b]  
✅ [b]Ramming armor buffed[/b] – Crash into enemies with more force!  
✅ [b]Ramming made easier[/b] – Adjustments make collisions more responsive and satisfying.  
✅ [b]Machinegun and Syphon buffed[/b] – More firepower where it matters!  
✅ [b]Shotgun Crew Member range increased[/b] – More effective in close-quarters combat.  

[b]⚖️ Balancing & Progression[/b]  
✅ [b]XP and enemy spawns reworked[/b] – Smoother difficulty scaling and pacing.  
✅ [b]Sandstorm warning lasts longer[/b] – More time to react before the storm hits!  
✅ [b]Dual Framing buffed[/b] – Improved life sustain for better survivability.  
✅ [b]Nitro buffed[/b] – Now has a 30-second cooldown instead of 40, so you can boost more often!  

[b]🔧 Fixes[/b]  
✅ [b]Sawblades now get destroyed properly[/b] – Some sawblades were not being destroyed upon touch, now that's fixed. 
✅ [b]Critical chance and bullet spread fixed[/b] – Crits now trigger correctly, and bullet spread behaves as intended.  
✅ [b]Crash fixes[/b] – Resolved an issue causing crashes in the main menu.  
✅ [b]F11 no longer changes window mode[/b] – Prevents conflicts with Steam bindings.  

[b]✨ Polish & Quality of Life[/b]  
✅ [b]New fonts for better readability[/b] – Some text has been updated for a clearer look. We're still fine-tuning this, so expect further improvements!  
✅ [b]Localization improvements[/b] – Including updated German translations.  
✅ [b]UI tweaks and general polish[/b] – Small improvements to enhance your experience.  
✅ [b]New Controls & Aim Mode Selection Screen[/b] – Before your first run, you'll see a screen showing controls for both gamepad and keyboard/mouse. You can also choose between Automatic or Manual aim/shoot mode—this can be adjusted anytime in the settings menu.  

And as always, this is just the beginning! More updates and improvements are on the way. Try out the latest version and let us know what you think!  

👉 Join the discussion in our community: [url=https://discord.gg/YjGATbJeg9]Join our Discord![/url]  

See you on the battlefield! 🚗💥

notes.title: Development update and new Trailer
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone again![/b] This last month has been intense and absolutely crazy (like every month, honestly haha). Here's a summary of the updates:

[h1][b]Development Updates[/b][/h1]

[b]New Enemies and Improvements:[/b]  
[list]
[*] Added new enemies like the Tesla Spider, Clawguard, and an early iteration of a giant robotic Scorpion boss with unique animations and behaviors.
[*] Attack animations implemented for all enemies.
[*] Improved LODs for several enemies to enhance performance.
[*] Added VFX for electric explosions, green fire (chemical explosions with area damage), and molotov projectiles.
[*] Fixed numerous bugs, such as cars flying when colliding with objects or getting stuck in props.
[/list]

[b]New Mechanics and Adjustments:[/b]  
[list]
[*] Implemented the crew member pickup mechanic, resolving bugs related to double pickups.
[*] Bosses now have 10x more health, but their damage has been reduced to balance combat.
[*] Explosive objects now leave persistent damage zones upon impact.
[*] The ramming shield (yellow bar above health) has been reworked. For now, it prevents slowing down when hitting enemies, allowing players to dodge attacks. However, it feels unclear and might become a spare part in the future.
[/list]

[b]Improved Maps:[/b]  
[list]
[*] Paris map received visual upgrades, with new decorative elements like sign textures and additional vegetation.
[*] Desert map optimized with collision and navmesh fixes. Players can now drive under the Brandenburg Gate.
[/list]

[b]UI and Gameplay:[/b]  
[list]
[*] Improved visibility of minimap icons, including off-screen markers.
[*] Adjusted the logic for abilities and balanced stats.
[*] Enhanced crew member pickups, making them larger, more appealing, and easier to collect.
[/list]

[h1][b]Events and Marketing[/b][/h1]

[b]Talk&Play in Berlin:[/b] Showcased Driveloop at this physical event, receiving great feedback from developers and players.

[b]DevGAMM Steam Fest:[/b] Participated for 10 days in this digital event, gaining visibility and a few wishlists.

[b]Upcoming Events:[/b]  
[list]
[*] Confirmed attendance at Bullet Heaven Fest and the BIG Conference in Bilbao (both in December). Hoping to gather feedback and wishlist growth.
[/list]  
[b]Marketing Progress:[/b]  
[list]
[*] Our marketing agency has contacted over 600 media outlets for the official game announcement.
[*] We have finished a long and more cinematic trailertrailer (around 1 min)! Check it out at the end of the post.
[*] Updated the Steam page with new images and text: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183730/Driveloop/. More improvements (better gifs, a new trailer, polished translations) are planned for January.
[/list]

[h1][b]Next Steps[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Addressing feedback from Talk&Play ahead of the BIG Conference in Bilbao.
[*] Launching the closed beta on Steam after the Bilbao event, avoiding manual build distribution.
[*] Post-BIG, dedicating a month to finalize remaining features (e.g., outgame progression like an item shop) and adding more content.
[/list]
